definitions.explanation: A white powder obtained by heating limestone, used in construction, agriculture, and industry. Also refers to lime-based substances in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{石灰|せっかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まいて⟦{土|つち}→土：02229_tsuchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{酸度|さんど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調整|ちょうせい}する→調整する：10442_chouseisuru⟧。
examples.english: To spread lime on a field to adjust the soil's acidity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{石灰岩|せっかいがん}→石灰岩：23396_sekkaigan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{鍾乳石|しょうにゅうせき}→鍾乳石：24538_shounyuuseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{形成|けいせい}→形成：12541_keisei⟧⟦され→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{年月|ねんげつ}→年月：00310_nengetsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧⟦{景観|けいかん}→景観：12976_keikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: In limestone caves, stalactites form, and beautiful scenery develops over long periods of time.

notes:
A compound of {石|せき} (stone) and {灰|かい} (ash). Traditionally, {石灰|せっかい} was used to draw white lines on school playgrounds and sports fields. Modern safety concerns have led many schools to switch to alternative materials. In agriculture, it is widely used to reduce soil acidity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {石灰|せっかい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧まく: to spread lime
- ⟦{石灰岩|せっかいがん}→石灰岩：23396_sekkaigan⟧: limestone
- {生|せい}{石灰|せっかい}: quicklime (calcium oxide)
- {消|しょう}{石灰|せっかい}: slaked lime (calcium hydroxide)
- {石灰|せっかい}{水|すい}: limewater
- {石灰|せっかい}⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧: calcareous; limy

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ライム: lime — the loanword; more often refers to the citrus fruit in Japanese
- ⟦チョーク→チョーク：24407_chooku⟧: chalk — chalk for writing on blackboards; related but not the same substance
- ⟦カルシウム→カルシウム：10963_karushiumu⟧: calcium — the element itself; {石灰|せっかい} is a calcium compound
